---
title: "LFS: Longitudinal Labour Force Survey"
description: "Person-month longitudinal labour force survey information for Australia’s resident civilian population aged 15 years and over."
---

Person-month longitudinal labour force survey information for Australia’s resident civilian population aged 15 years and over.

*Describes the survey scope, longitudinal file structure, coverage and data item list.*
